groups.mode: solo; Ivara Sleep Arrow or Equinox sleep

rows.label: Visitor rank-up
rows.note: 22,000 standing, 25,000cr, 10 Tear Azurite, 40 Pyrol, 60 Fish Scales

conditions: Everything counts against the daily Ostron cap, so the climb spans several days whatever the method.
Budget the part blueprints, the Esher Devar (2,500) and Fersteel (5,000) refining blueprints and the 5,000-standing gild on top of the rank-ups.
bonuses: Sleeping an animal counts as a perfect tranq capture; players report hitting the cap in 6-20 minutes this way.
Vampire Kavats at night around the small lakes northeast of the right-most central teleport pay about 2k per cycle; go solo so the spawns behave.
Condrocs spawn in threes and are the fallback target without Ivara.

groups.activity: buy the Strike, Grip and Link blueprints

rows.label: Laka Grip Blueprint
rows.alt: a two-handed Grip makes a Hammer

rows.label: Ruhang Link Blueprint
rows.alt: Jai, same cost but needs Condroc Wing and Khut-Khut Venom Sac

conditions: Mastery belongs to the Strike alone; the cheapest Grip and Link are fine.
A forged Zaw can never be taken apart, so pick the Grip before forging.

groups.activity: mine, refine, fish and gather the build materials

rows.label: Grokdrul
rows.note: Strike; drums in Grineer camps, bounty rewards

rows.label: Fish Scales
rows.note: Strike; fillet any fish at Hai-Luk

rows.label: Esher Devar
rows.note: Strike; refine 10 Devar, blueprint needs Offworlder

rows.label: Fersteel Alloy
rows.note: Strike; refine Ferros, blueprint needs Visitor

rows.label: Cryotic
rows.note: Laka Grip; Excavation, not the Plains

conditions: The Esher Devar and Fersteel refining blueprints are reusable and shared by other Zaw, Amp and Kitgun parts.
bonuses: Most of these drop while you are on the Plains for standing anyway.

rows.label: Rabvee Strike
rows.note: 5,000cr, 35 Grokdrul, 50 Fish Scales, 10 Esher Devar, 20 Fersteel Alloy

rows.label: Laka Grip
rows.note: 5,000cr, 20 Nistlepod, 60 Coprite Alloy, 50 Fish Oil, 750 Cryotic

rows.label: Ruhang Link
rows.note: 5,000cr, 10 Nistlepod, 20 Pyrotic Alloy, 2 Kuaka Spinal Claw, 5 Mawfish Bones

rows.label: gild
rows.note: 2 Cetus Wisp + 5,000 Ostron standing, Trusted rank; resets to rank 0

rows.label: level to 30 again
rows.note: this pass is what pays Mastery

conditions: An ungilded Zaw at rank 30 gives no Mastery, and a second Rabvee Zaw gives nothing once one is mastered.
A freshly gilded Zaw hides its new polarity slot while you are in Cetus; it shows up back on the Orbiter.
bonuses: Donate the mastered Zaw back to Hok for Ostron standing; Update 39.1 asks for confirmation first.

disclosures.title: Machete holster bug
disclosures.body: The one-handed Machete build stays in hand when you switch to a gun and is locked to the Nikana holster style. It is cosmetic; a two-handed Grip for the Hammer avoids it.
